description: The commit summary's test counts (GET /api/tests/commit/{sha}/summary): per worst result the tests and their jobs, and for the whole commit the tests, jobs and bundles of each status and the span of the runs. before: the statement the working tree is compared with, recorded rather than regenerated: until 2026-11-05 every retained run of the commit's jobs read with FINAL and grouped into bundles, the functional baseline; since each case's `regenerated` note, the counts query it replaced, which had been recorded equal to that baseline. after: the working-tree SQL, which groups the commit's rows by job and test through by_job, classifies the keys holding one stored row straight off their outcome and reads FINAL only for the other keys' rows at their shared starts, each test's bundles aggregated as parallel arrays of jobs and ranks. Each case runs alternating pairs and requires identical complete rows (sorted by category). The lookups, the commit's own, its pull request's title, the pull request its SHA has been the head of (a fork head's) and its branch neighbours, are recorded for SQL drift and run once live.

fixtures.commit_97a3cf6: A main commit of 2026-10-24 with 1,006 jobs whose stored rows hold 28 shared test starts (56 rows, measured 2026-11-05).
